name: Father Brown
description: Father Brown is based on G. K. Chesterton's detective stories about a Catholic priest who doubles as an amateur detective in order to try and solve mysteries.

videos.title: The Hammer of God
videos.overview: When an ungodly man is murdered at the unveiling of a new church clock,  Father Brown must find the killer before an innocent woman is sent to  the gallows.

videos.title: The Flying Stars
videos.overview: Father Brown becomes embroiled with a theatrical family when he discovers that a supposed tragic drowning was actually murder.

videos.title: The Wrong Shape
videos.overview: Soon  after his poetry recital, Leonard Quinton is found hanging in the  conservatory. When Father Brown realises that he could not have  committed suicide, the search begins for a murderer.

videos.title: The Man in the Tree
videos.overview: When  Lady Felicia finds a stripped and injured man stuck up a tree, Sid is  implicated as the perpetrator. Can Father Brown prove his innocence, or  has Sid gone too far this time?

videos.title: The Eye of Apollo
videos.overview: When  the Church of Apollo comes to Kembleford, Susie is drawn to their  charismatic leader Kalon. After Kalon's wife is murdered, Father Brown  must break his spell over Susie or risk losing her forever.

videos.title: The Bride of Christ
videos.overview: When  two nuns die in mysterious circumstances at St Agnes convent, Father  Brown investigates with the aid of Sister Boniface, an eager young fan  of detective novels.

videos.title: The Devil's Dust
videos.overview: Father Brown joins the search when a girl who is believed to be radioactive goes missing overnight. But just who is responsible for her disappearance?

videos.title: The Face of Death
videos.overview: After a murder at the Kembleford charity treasure hunt, general suspicion falls upon a bereaved man who wants revenge. However, Father Brown is determined to prove the man's innocence.

videos.title: The Mayor and the Magician
videos.overview: When the mayor drops dead during his speech at the Kembleford village fete, Father Brown deduces that he was deliberately electrocuted. Meanwhile, Mrs McCarthy's past comes back to haunt her.

videos.title: The Blue Cross
videos.overview: When his priceless Blue Cross is targeted by the infamous criminal Flambeau, Father Brown takes the initiative to try and save his soul. But is he walking into a trap?

videos.title: The Ghost in the Machine
videos.overview: Father  Brown is sceptical when a parishioner believes she's being haunted by  her sister who went missing years ago. However, when she herself  vanishes, he must investigate both disappearances.

videos.title: Maddest of All
videos.overview: When  an ex-serviceman drops dead in the street, Father Brown investigates the  facility where he was a patient. Could something sinister lie beneath  the surface at Danvers Retreat?

videos.title: The Pride of the Prydes
videos.overview: The  grand opening of Pryde Castle ends in disaster when a guide is struck by  an arrow. Contrary to Inspector Sullivan, Father Brown becomes  convinced that the motive lies buried in the family's past.

videos.title: The Shadow of the Scaffold
videos.overview: When  convicted killer Violet is given a temporary reprieve from the gallows,  she begs Father Brown to prove her innocence. With only three days in  hand, can he find the real culprit before it's too late?

videos.title: The Mysteries of the Rosary
videos.overview: The  mysterious disappearance of an old friend sends Father Brown and Sid on a  quest to find the mythical Lannington Rosary. However can an old  adversary, back from the dead, be trusted to help?

videos.title: The Daughters of Jerusalem
videos.overview: Father  Brown finds himself immobilised with a broken leg when a member of  Kembleford's WI dies in mysterious circumstances. Can he crack the case  armed only with a telescope and the gang to help?

videos.title: The Three Tools of Death
videos.overview: When a  troubled young woman's father is killed just weeks after her mother's  death, Father Brown must help her deal with her grief, while solving the  father's inexplicable murder by one of three weapons.

videos.title: The Prize of Colonel Gerard
videos.overview: Father  Brown is unconvinced when a recently returned prisoner of war is  suspected of the killing of his tyrannical uncle. And it seems that  someone will stop at nothing to keep the priest from the truth...

videos.title: The Grim Reaper
videos.overview: Through  a series of poison pen letters, a gruesome death on a local farm is  blamed on the Kembleford physician. Father Brown must figure out who  sent them in order to save his friend from the gallows.

videos.title: The Laws of Motion
videos.overview: A day  out at a local hill climb track ends with one of the drivers killed in a  car crash. When Father Brown will not stop investigating, an infuriated  Sullivan resolves to put an end to his meddling for good.

videos.title: The Man in the Shadows
videos.overview: Father Brown gets involved with MI5, which puts Lady Felicia in a compromising position.

videos.title: The Curse of Amenhotep
videos.overview: After Sir Raleigh's new bride insists on seeing his Egyptian mummy, she is found dead.

videos.title: The Invisible Man
videos.overview: The circus brings death to Kembleford when a clown is murdered.

videos.title: The Sign of the Broken Sword
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates a murder at the local army barracks.

videos.title: The Last Man
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when Kembleford's new cricket captain is framed for murder.

videos.title: The Upcott Fraternity
videos.overview: Father Brown witnesses the apparent suicide of a student but is convinced it is murder.

videos.title: The Kembleford Boggart
videos.overview: Father Brown must act fast to save a member of Kembleford's travelling community.

videos.title: The Lair of the Libertines
videos.overview: Father Brown and his friends find themselves stranded at a hotel with a group of hedonists

videos.title: The Truth in the Wine
videos.overview: When a body is discovered in a vineyard, Father Brown must search for the murderer.

videos.title: The Judgement of Man
videos.overview: Father Brown becomes embroiled in an audacious art heist masterminded by Flambeau.

videos.title: The Time Machine
videos.overview: Father Brown visits Jacob, who has a new invention - a time machine.

videos.title: The Standing Stones
videos.overview: A death at a stone circle leads Father Brown to conclude that dark forces are at work.

videos.title: The Paradise of Thieves
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when a dead man is found inside a locked bank vault.

videos.title: The Deadly Seal
videos.overview: Father Brown is told that Bishop Talbot will be assassinated.

videos.title: The Owl of Minerva
videos.overview: Father Brown is stunned to learn that Inspector Sullivan is wanted for murder.

videos.title: The Mask of the Demon
videos.overview: When the production of Demon Brides comes to Kembleford and the director of the film is murdered, Father Brown investigates.

videos.title: The Brewer's Daughter
videos.overview: Sid falls for the heiress of a local brewery, just before she is arrested on suspicion of murdering her father.

videos.title: The Hangman's Demise
videos.overview: Father Brown is called in to investigate the poisoning of a former hangman.

videos.title: The Crackpot of the Empire
videos.overview: A former music hall comedian swears revenge and traps Father Brown in a derelict building.

videos.title: The Daughter of Autolycus
videos.overview: Flambeau needs Father Brown's help in stealing the Pope's coronation gift to the Queen of England.

videos.title: The Rod of Asclepius
videos.overview: Lady Felicia winds up in hospital after some reckless driving.

videos.title: The Missing Man
videos.overview: Father Brown realises that an apparent suicide of a pilot is in fact murder.

videos.title: The Resurrectionists
videos.overview: Father Brown tries to find out why the body of a man has been taken from his grave.

videos.title: The Sins of the Father
videos.overview: Lady Felicia loses her singing voice. Father Brown investigates the murder of a local aeronautics magnate.

videos.title: The Wrath of Baron Samdi
videos.overview: Father Brown runs into a voodoo priest who will do anything to get the woman he loves back.

videos.title: The Star of Jacob
videos.overview: A mysterious stranger, a missing donkey, an outbreak of laryngitis in the church choir and a kidnapped baby threaten to spoil Kembleford's Christmas festivities.

videos.title: The Labyrinth of the Minotaur
videos.overview: Father Brown is asked to look after Lady Felicia's wayward niece Bunty, who soon finds herself suspected of murder.

videos.title: The Eve of St John
videos.overview: Father Brown struggles to promote understanding when a group of pagans are suspected of killing one of their own.

videos.title: The Chedworth Cyclone
videos.overview: Father Brown is drawn into the shady world of boxing when a local fighter is found dead in suspicious circumstances.

videos.title: The Hand of Lucia
videos.overview: When a local writer is murdered, Father Brown must delve into her infamous novel Lulu and Lucia for inspiration.

videos.title: The Eagle and the Daw
videos.overview: When an old foe tells him that she has arranged the death of her former lover, Father Brown soon finds himself blamed for the murder.

videos.title: The Smallest of Things
videos.overview: Past and present collide when Father Brown investigates the macabre world of dollhouse crime scenes.

videos.title: The Crimson Feather
videos.overview: When Mrs McCarthy's god-daughter goes missing, Father Brown follows her trail to a risque gentlemen's club.

videos.title: The Lepidopterist's Companion
videos.overview: When Mrs McCarthy takes over the running of the mobile library, Father Brown discovers a shocking secret lurking among the bookshelves.

videos.title: The Alchemist's Secret
videos.overview: Father Brown must investigate a 300 year old secret hidden in a University in order to save an old friend.

videos.title: The Sins of Others
videos.overview: Father Brown struggles to save Sid from himself when he vows vengeance on his former defence barrister.

videos.title: The Theatre of the Invisible
videos.overview: When radio quiz Up To You comes to Kembleford, Father Brown suspects that one of the cast are responsible for their landlady’s murder.

videos.title: The Tanganyika Green
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates the murder of a Colonial Postal Service officer when the fair comes to Kembleford.

videos.title: The Fire in the Sky
videos.overview: Father Brown’s divine inspiration is called upon when Kembleford comes under threat of an alien invasion.

videos.title: The Penitent Man
videos.overview: Father Brown suspects an ulterior motive is at play when his old adversary Flambeau is incarcerated for murder.

videos.title: The Tree of Truth
videos.overview: A skeleton from a seven-year-old murder case is found buried in the woods and doubts are cast on the conviction of the confessed killer.

videos.title: The Jackdaw's Revenge
videos.overview: Father Brown struggles to protect those closest to him when an old foe is unexpectedly released from prison.

videos.title: The Kembleford Dragon
videos.overview: Father Brown must stop a much-loved institution from going off the rails when the local stationmaster is murdered.

videos.title: The Angel of Mercy
videos.overview: Father Brown senses something sinister afoot when Mrs McCarthy's friend is the latest villager to die in her sleep.

videos.title: The Face of the Enemy
videos.overview: Father Brown spies trouble when Lady Felicia returns to Kembleford.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Mallory is forced to turn to Father Brown for help when a VIP policeman is murdered at a bowls match.

videos.title: The Dance of Death
videos.overview: Father Brown uncovers a dark secret when a contestant is murdered at a ballroom dancing competition.

videos.title: The Cat of Mastigatus
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when a girl is found left for dead at a boys' school fete.

videos.title: The Flower of the Fairway
videos.overview: Local feathers are ruffled when an ostentatious American opens up a golf club near Kembleford and a body is discovered in the reeds.

videos.title: The Two Deaths of Hercule Flambeau
videos.overview: Following reports of Flambeau's death, Father Brown races to protect a crown that contains a nail from the crucifixion of Christ.

videos.title: The Great Train Robbery
videos.overview: Lady Felicia and Mrs McCarthy are taken hostage when a midnight train robbery goes awry.

videos.title: The Passing Bell
videos.overview: A new musical director for the bell-ringers of St Marys leads to discord, disharmony and the blood-curdling sound of murder.

videos.title: The Whistle in the Dark
videos.overview: Father Brown must intervene when it appears that a dark spirit has murderous intent.

videos.title: The Demise of the Debutante
videos.overview: Father Brown uncovers secrets, hypocrisy and murder at a finishing school for young ladies.

videos.title: The Darkest Noon
videos.overview: When Father Brown and Mallory go missing, it's up to the gang to save them from a man hell-bent on revenge.

videos.title: The Sacrifice of Tantalus
videos.overview: When Mallory's pursuit of a fugitive ends in disaster, a familiar face returns to hunt the culprit.

videos.title: The House of God
videos.overview: Suspicions are aroused when the holiest house in Kembleford is linked to the death of a wanton woman.

videos.title: The Blood of the Anarchists
videos.overview: Tensions rise to deadly levels when a performance troupe of anarchists arrive in Kembleford.

videos.title: The Skylark Scandal
videos.overview: The Kembleford Ramblers annual outing takes a tragic turn when the local Lord is found strangled.

videos.title: The Honourable Thief
videos.overview: When Lady Felicia's home comes under threat, Father Brown is forced to seek help from an unlikely ally.

videos.title: The Celestial Choir
videos.overview: A mysterious saboteur tries to stop Kembleford winning the Three Counties choir competition.

videos.title: The Queen Bee
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates the mysterious death of a beekeeper.

videos.title: The Scales of Justice
videos.overview: Father Brown races to save Bunty from the hangman's noose when she is tried for murder.

videos.title: The Wisdom of the Fool
videos.overview: Murder is no laughing matter when Father Brown visits a jester convention.

videos.title: The Folly of Jephthah
videos.overview: Flambeau seeks Father Brown's help to get rid of an unwanted rival.

videos.title: The Numbers of the Beast
videos.overview: Mrs McCarthy strikes it lucky at the church bingo with the help of a Romani fortune teller.

videos.title: The River Corrupted
videos.overview: Sid returns to Kembleford to ask his old family to help save his new one.

videos.title: The Curse of the Aesthetic
videos.overview: Father Brown must discover who is out to kill a tortured artist before it's too late.

videos.title: The Fall of the House of St Gardner
videos.overview: A gossip columnist is murdered after threatening to expose the secrets of a fashion house.

videos.title: The Tower of Lost Souls
videos.overview: Father Brown joins forces with Chief Inspector Valentine to uncover a dark secret at Helmsley House.

videos.title: The Menace of Mephistopheles
videos.overview: Goodfellow turns to Father Brown when he witnesses Mallory frame an innocent man.

videos.title: The Viper's Tongue
videos.overview: Mrs McCarthy gets an unwelcome birthday surprise when her life is threatened by a mysterious avenging angel.

videos.title: The Requiem for the Dead
videos.overview: Father Brown must delve into the past and open up old wounds when a child killer is found murdered.

videos.title: The Children of Kalon
videos.overview: When a troubled soul from the past returns, Father Brown must investigate the new chapter of the Church of Apollo.

videos.title: The Final Devotion
videos.overview: Father Brown joins forces with Flambeau to search for a lost treasure in a 15th-century castle.

videos.title: The New Order
videos.overview: Father Brown finds his position under threat when he clashes with an influential new parishioner.

videos.title: The Island of Dreams
videos.overview: When Father Brown visits Chummy's holiday camp, it doesn't take long for someone to die-de-die.

videos.title: The Wayward Girls
videos.overview: Bunty reunites with Father Brown to uncover a dark secret at the local girls' borstal.

videos.title: The Enigma of Antigonish
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates staff at the local health spa when an ex-employee is found murdered.

videos.title: The Red Death
videos.overview: Lady Felicia’s lavish New Year ball is ruined when a VIP is murdered.

videos.title: The Winds of Change
videos.overview: Father Brown discovers that a murderer is using Kembleford’s new model village to plan their attacks. He also needs to find a new secretary following Mrs McCarthy’s departure.

videos.title: The Company of Men
videos.overview: Lady Felicia’s impromptu visit coincides with Father Brown helping out a friend at an exclusive gentlemen’s club.

videos.title: The Gardeners of Eden
videos.overview: A celebrity florist brings glamour and murder to Kembleford.

videos.title: The Beast of Wedlock
videos.overview: Father Brown’s past collides with the present when he investigates a missing person, a murder and a mythical wild cat.

videos.title: The Hidden Man
videos.overview: Chief Inspector Sullivan pays Father Brown a visit to warn him that Hercule Flambeau is on the run and wanted for a series of brutal murders.

videos.title: The Royal Visit
videos.overview: The visit of Princess Margaret to Kembleford is jeopardised when a school janitor is found murdered.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Father Brown discovers there’s more drama offstage than on in the latest production by the Kembleford Players.

videos.title: The Sands of Time
videos.overview: Brenda finds love at the home of a clock collector, but has she fallen for a killer?

videos.title: The Wheels of Wrath
videos.overview: Rock 'n' roll reaches Kembleford when a group of bikers cause outrage and excitement in equal measure.

videos.title: The Serpent Within
videos.overview: Sullivan’s dream of leaving Kembleford is scuppered when he is arrested for receiving stolen goods.

videos.title: The Kembleston Olimpicks
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when rivalries escalate to murderous heights at the Kembleston Olimpicks.

videos.title: The Forensic Nun
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when his old friend Sister Boniface is implicated in the murder of a renowned artist.

videos.title: The Hermit of Hazelnut Cottage
videos.overview: Brenda faces ghosts from her past and becomes embroiled in a local dispute that ends in murder.

videos.title: The Last Supper
videos.overview: Father Brown has a lot on his plate when a food fayre comes to Kembleford, bringing murder with it.

videos.title: The Father, The Son
videos.overview: Flambeau is stunned to find his estranged father at St Mary’s, who has a dangerous mission in mind.

videos.title: The Quill of Osric
videos.overview: Father Brown must discover the culprit when a novelist is attacked at a crime-writing festival.

videos.title: The Word of the Condemned
videos.overview: Lady Felicia asks Father Brown to help prove a convicted serial killer didn’t murder her beloved goddaughter.

videos.title: The Last Tango in Kembleford
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when the competitive atmosphere at a local dance school leads to a dance with death.

videos.title: The Dead of Night
videos.overview: Father Brown is determined to unmask a mortal being when a supposed vampire strikes in the village.

videos.title: The Scars of War
videos.overview: Sullivan asks for Father Brown’s help when Mrs Devine’s son Eddie is framed for murder.

videos.title: The Battle of Kembleford
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when a medieval murder is committed at a battle re-enactment.

videos.title: The Kembleston Players
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when rehearsals for ‘A Most Perfect Murder’ are derailed by a dramatic death.

videos.title: The Horns of Cernunnos
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when an old friend’s daughter is plagued by otherworldly visions.

videos.title: The Invisible Friends
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when murder threatens to derail the live broadcast of agricultural radio drama The Muckles.

videos.title: The Cup of Calabria
videos.overview: Father Brown and Flambeau hunt for a priceless holy relic as a new nemesis lurks in the shadows.

videos.title: The Lord of the Dance
videos.overview: Father Brown takes the lead when a television dancing contest turns deadly.

videos.title: The Deserving Poor
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when his old friend, Blind ‘Arry, is arrested for murder at an almshouse.

videos.title: The Sisters of Aeschylus
videos.overview: When Lady Felicia invites a prestigious group of writers to Montague, her hopes of being published are eclipsed by a murder.

videos.title: The Puzzle of Banburismus
videos.overview: Father Brown must untangle the mysteries that lie within the sewing circle when a seamstress is stabbed to death.

videos.title: The Blessing of the Father
videos.overview: Mrs Devine and Sullivan’s wedding approaches, but can Father Brown stop a would-be killer from ruining their big day?

videos.title: The Good Refuge
videos.overview: Mrs McCarthy makes a surprise return to Kembleford and joins Father Brown to investigate one more murder.

videos.title: The Hole in My Heart
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when rock ‘n’ roll sensations The Hart Brothers return home to Kembleford, bringing murder with them.

videos.title: The Palace by the Sea
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates beside the seaside when Sullivan’s beloved Aunty Pat is arrested for murder.

videos.title: The Crackpot and the Dummy
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when an old friend, eccentric ventriloquist Uncle Mirth, is arrested for murder.

videos.title: The Shadow of Lazarus
videos.overview: Father Brown and Flambeau play a deadly game of cat and mouse with their nemesis Father Lazarus.

videos.title: The Obedient Wife
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when Violet Goodfellow is attacked by the killer of a senior policeman.

videos.title: The Bodhi Tree
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when Lady Felicia’s friend drops dead during a yoga session at a Buddhist retreat.

videos.title: The Oath of Silence
videos.overview: Father Brown is in a race against time to prove the innocence of a man standing trial for murder.

videos.title: The Power of Suggestion
videos.overview: Father Brown investigates when a Hollywood starlet is murdered while filming an advert for washing powder.

videos.title: The Bishop's Revenge
videos.overview: After taking revenge on Father Brown, bishop-elect Fox is kidnapped. Can the priest find him in time for his consecration?
